answer_2.quote: Evaluation We utilize the mir_eval library (Raffel et al., 2014) for performance evaluation. Specifically, we apply the metrics proposed in : COn (correct onset), COff (correct offset), COnP (correct onset and pitch), COnPOff (correct onset, pitch, and offset). An average overlap ratio (AOR) is also calculated for correctly transcribed note duration, and a raw pitch accuracy (RPA) for overall perception performance.

answer_4.quote: For subjective evaluation, we conducted crowdsourced mean opinion score (MOS) listening tests. Specifically, we score MOS-P and MOS-Q corresponding to pitch reconstruction and overall quality.
answer_4.guideline: For MOS-P, listeners are exposed to GT samples and instructed to concentrate on pitch reconstruction, disregarding audio quality. For MOS-Q, the focus is on overall synthesis quality, encompassing clarity and naturalness.
